SELECT `o`.`order_status`, COUNT(*) AS `order_count`, SUM(`o`.`pay_amount`) AS `total_pay_amount`
FROM `trd_order` AS `o`
JOIN `dim_shop` AS `s` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `s`.`id`
JOIN `prd_brand` AS `b` ON `s`.`brand_id` = `b`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` AS `r` ON `s`.`region_id` = `r`.`id`
WHERE `b`.`name` = '曜石'
  AND `r`.`big_region` = '华东'
  AND `o`.`paid_at` IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (`o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-10-12' AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-10-19')
    OR
    (`o`.`paid_at` >= '2026-10-05' AND `o`.`paid_at` < '2026-10-12')
  )
GROUP BY `o`.`order_status`;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-12' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-19' THEN '本期'
        WHEN r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-05' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-12' THEN '上期'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS `period`,
    r.`reason_code`,
    COUNT(*) AS `refund_count`,
    SUM(r.`refund_amount`) AS `refund_amount_sum`
FROM `trd_refund` r
JOIN `trd_order` o ON r.`order_id` = o.`id`
JOIN `dim_shop` s ON o.`shop_id` = s.`id`
JOIN `prd_brand` b ON s.`brand_id` = b.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` reg ON s.`region_id` = reg.`id`
WHERE b.`name` = '曜石'
    AND reg.`big_region` = '华东'
    AND r.`refund_status` = 'SUCCESS'
    AND (
        (r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-12' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-19')
        OR (r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-05' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-12')
    )
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-12' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-19' THEN '本期'
        WHEN r.`created_time` >= '2026-10-05' AND r.`created_time` < '2026-10-12' THEN '上期'
        ELSE NULL
    END,
    r.`reason_code`;

SELECT `w`.`name`, COUNT(*) AS `stockout_count`, SUM(`s`.`shortage_qty`) AS `total_shortage_qty`
FROM `wms_stockout_record` AS `s`
JOIN `trd_order` AS `o` ON `s`.`order_id` = `o`.`id`
JOIN `dim_shop` AS `shop` ON `o`.`shop_id` = `shop`.`id`
JOIN `prd_brand` AS `b` ON `shop`.`brand_id` = `b`.`id`
JOIN `dim_region` AS `r` ON `shop`.`region_id` = `r`.`id`
JOIN `wms_warehouse` AS `w` ON `s`.`warehouse_id` = `w`.`id`
WHERE `b`.`name` = '曜石'
  AND `r`.`big_region` = '华东'
  AND `s`.`created_time` >= '2026-10-12' AND `s`.`created_time` < '2026-10-19'
GROUP BY `w`.`name`;
